evidence: Static source check, which is the full scope of this row. task/task.toml:20-24 [environment] contains only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; there is no docker_image key there, and none under [verifier.environment] (task.toml:37-38). A recursive text search of the frozen task tree for 'docker_image' returns no match. task/environment/Dockerfile:1-26 has active build steps (FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt-get install at 5-7, npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1 at 9-12, COPY instructions/ and assets/ at 14-15, git init of /app at 16-23), so the Dockerfile is the image source and is not shadowed. task/environment holds only Dockerfile, assets/ and instructions/ (no docker-compose file that could substitute an image). Both the [environment] block and the Dockerfile are identical in content to the frozen template (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml:20-24 and environment/Dockerfile:1-26). Matches staged-task-contract.md:78 and quality-checks.md:53-54. Adversarial consideration: a shadowing image would leave /instructions and /assets missing for the agent; no such setting exists. The raw evidence index records the scripted golden as run 'in the agent image', which is consistent but is not needed for and not relied on by this verdict; no build was run by this reviewer (Docker not used).
